== Usage ==
Shows Field Procedures related to the current reference page from the canonical procedure metadata in [[Module:Procedures]] and its data modules.

<pre>{{Related procedures}}</pre>
<pre>{{Related procedures|page=Refinery}}</pre>
<pre>{{Related procedures|topic=Mining}}</pre>

Use this instead of manually maintaining duplicate procedure lists on reference pages whenever the relationship is already recorded in procedure metadata.
